subject: Novaprime: pricing exception request — need forecast decision
messages:
From: Julie Martin <julie.martin@novaprime.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Novaprime Procurement <procurement@novaprime.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot pricing question — discount request

Hi Ethan,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week. Procurement is pushing hard for a discounted rate to make the Q4 pilot budgeted — they are asking for a 20% concession for the 6-month pilot term.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can approve this level of discount, or whether we need to route to Deal Desk + Finance? If it helps, I attached the SOW they expect to sign and the rough bill schedule. Novaprime needs a pricing answer this week to keep the vendor review on track.

Appreciate quick clarity — Julie

Attachments: Novaprime_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW stub), budget_schedule.xlsx (stub)

From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Julie Martin <julie.martin@novaprime.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot pricing question — discount request

Team — forwarding Novaprime's ask. Key facts: 6-month pilot, ARR impact is modest (~$120k ARR if converted), procurement pushing for 20% off list. Buyer is strategic (security-sensitive) and likely to expand if pilot goes well.

Quick asks:
- Karthik: can Deal Desk approve any concession off list for pilot? If yes, what approvals are required (finance signoff, sales leader)?
- Monica: if we grant a concession, will Finance accept this as a committed discount for forecasting, or do we need a contract clause tied to signature/PO timing?
- Vanessa: recommend we either hold to list or approve a smaller concession to protect forecast. Thoughts?

I've attached our suggested pricing matrix for reference (pricing_matrix_20260814.xlsx).

Thanks,
Ethan

--
Ethan Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ethan.park@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0214

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 08:29:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot pricing question — discount request

Ethan / team —

Deal Desk can approve concessions up to 12% for pilot engagements without escalating to CRO, provided Finance signs off on the forecast treatment. Anything above 12% needs Deal Desk + VP approval and will be treated as a non-standard concession in our CRM (requires written LOE and executive sign-off).

For forecast integrity: Finance requires one of the following before we treat the deal as committed in the month-end numbers:
- Signed SOW (DocuSign) with discount applied, or
- Executed PO referencing the SOW, or
- Written procurement email committing to spend with an agreed payment schedule.

If Novaprime can only commit after procurement review the week after next, we should not mark full-commit for Aug. Options:
1) Offer a 12% concession now (Deal Desk ok) with 30-day signature expectation — Finance can treat as a pending commit but only include 50% of value in this cycle.
2) Hold to list price and push for signature — preserves forecast accuracy.
3) Approve 20% but escalate (will delay approval until VP sign-off and risks forecast exclusion until signature).

Recommend (1) to keep the deal moving but surface the partial commit to Revenue Ops so forecasting reflects uncertainty.

-Karthik
Deal Desk Manager | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Julie Martin <julie.martin@novaprime.com>, Finance Team <finance@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot pricing question — discount request

Ethan / all —

After reviewing the opportunity and given the expansion potential, I approve a constrained concession: we will offer Novaprime a 12% pilot discount (Deal Desk-approved). Conditions:
- Discount applied only to the 6-month pilot term in the attached updated SOW (Novaprime_SOW_updated_20260818.pdf).
- SOW must be signed via DocuSign by close of business 31 Aug 2026.
- Finance will mark 50% of the pilot value as committed for August forecasting until signature is received.
- If Novaprime requests >12%, we escalate to VP for consideration (expect at least 48-72 hour review).

Ethan — please send the updated SOW to Julie and procurement, copy Finance, and confirm the DocuSign link. Also update HubSpot with concession reason and set deal stage to "Pilot - SOW sent (Concession)".

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Sales | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
--
